text:
rachel: quick question — a customer hit a tiny bump during onboarding with the Ruby SDK sample. They open the sample, run the app, and see `Net::HTTPUnauthorized` when the token rotates. The JS SDK retries on 401, ruby currently bubbles.

omar: is this the same retry behavior we discussed last quarter? I vaguely remember we left it out for concurrency concerns.

rachel: yep. minimal repro steps in the customer's note: start sample, simulate token expiry, single request -> 401 -> app error. They expect "transparent refresh" like other SDKs.

sdk-maintainer: I have a small PR that adds an `auth_retry` wrapper and an option `auto_refresh` (default true). It takes a mutex so only one refresh runs on concurrent 401s. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/101

omar: nice. two things to watch: 1) ensure we have a max retries + exponential backoff with jitter, 2) make the env override available for ops teams (REDWOOD_RUBY_AUTO_REFRESH=false) so they can opt out in production.

ci-bot: CI: test matrix ruby-3.2 / ubuntu-latest failed on job "unit-specs" due to a flakey network stub (timed out). Rerun suggested.

sdk-maintainer: added backoff + jitter and wired `max_retries`. Also added a unit test that spawns 8 threads, forces the first request to 401, and asserts only one token refresh call was made. The test is intentionally small.

omar: please add a short migration note in CHANGELOG (behavior change). Also update samples/README.md to show how to disable auto refresh while keeping the sample friendly for quick trials.

samira: from product side: we should be conservative with defaults, but given parity with JS and fewer support tickets, default true seems ok. Add a short blurb in onboarding checklist so support can triage older SDK versions.

rachel: added README snippet showing `client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], auto_refresh: false)` and an example `export REDWOOD_RUBY_AUTO_REFRESH=false` for quick rollbacks. Pushed the commits.

sdk-maintainer: CI green on rerun. Will merge after a maintainer review.

omar: approved. small nit: include a line in CONTRIBUTING about avoiding global bundler pins in samples to reduce onboarding friction.

rachel: done. Also updated the sample Gemfile comment to suggest `bundle update --bundler` if users hit a bundler mismatch.

samira: thanks — please send a short note to #new-hires and #support when merged so folks know the sample behavior changed.

sdk-maintainer: merged and cut patch release v0.4.2 with changelog: "Ruby SDK: optional auto_refresh + concurrency-safe token refresh; sample docs updated".

omar: resolving. :white_check_mark:
